title: closing-bible receipt (closing-receipt.json)
description: PRD §4 outputs: 'closing-receipt.json reconciling expected items, selected sources, included outputs and page counts.' The balance. Recomputed after every run, printed as one line, shown even when complete. expected_items must equal the sum over by_status and every distinct source must sit in exactly one family, or the script refuses to write it (PRD §7: complete source and expected-item accounting). In audit mode included_outputs is empty.

unreadable.description: Distinct source documents whose census readability is encrypted, corrupt or suspect. Any value above 0 fails the receipt (status-taxonomy.md outcomes).

skipped.description: Entries the census listed under skipped[] with reason symlink-outside-root, unreadable-directory or special-file. Hidden entries are listed but not counted. Any value above 0 keeps the receipt from complete.

inspected.description: Families with a valid inspection record. Fewer than families means some were not looked at; the gap is named in exceptions.md, never absorbed.

rejected.description: Inspection records that failed validation (wrong members, disallowed status, ready on filename-only evidence). Each is named in exceptions.md with its reason.

package.description: build/update only; null in audit. The versioned package this receipt describes (assembly-rules.md).

combined_pdf.description: closing-bible.pdf, or null when it could not be built (no pypdf) or volumes were written.

included_outputs.description: build/update only: one row per plan entry, page counts reconciled to the selected source (or its verified conversion). Empty in audit mode.

output.description: The indexed-set file name, and the combined PDF (or volume) page range when included there.
